"""Plot numerical joint-limit profiles with validated sign-enclosure markers."""
from fractions import Fraction
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from smatrix_bootstrap.impact_parameter import impact_profile


def main():
    audits=[Path('results/impact_pure_N6_interval_edges.json'),Path('results/impact_gauge_N6_F21.json')]
    titles=['Pure pion N6, interval edges','Coupled N6/F21, interval edges and FF samples']
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10.5,4),layout='constrained')
    colors=['#1768ac','#d16b20','#7e4585'];grid=np.linspace(1.5,5,120)
    inputs={}
    for ax,path,title in zip(axes,audits,titles):
        report=json.loads(path.read_text());candidate=Path(report['candidate'])
        archived=json.loads(candidate.read_text());sol=archived['rounds'][-1]['solution'] if 'rounds' in archived else archived['solution']
        degree=report['profiles'][0]['validated']['degree']
        values=np.array([impact_profile(b,sol['coefficients'],degree)['profile'] for b in grid])
        for i,color in enumerate(colors):
            ax.plot(grid,values[:,i],color=color,label=f'I = {i}')
            for profile in report['profiles']:
                cert=profile['validated'];interval=cert['channels'][i]['enclosure']
                lo=float(Fraction(interval['lower_rational']));hi=float(Fraction(interval['upper_rational']))
                ax.errorbar(float(Fraction(cert['b'])),(hi+lo)/2,yerr=(hi-lo)/2,
                    color=color,fmt='D',ms=4,capsize=3)
        ax.axhline(0,color='black',lw=.8)
        ax.set_yscale('symlog',linthresh=1e-4)
        ax.set(xlabel=r'$b=2(\ell+1/2)/\sqrt{s}$',ylabel=r'$H_I(b)$',title=title)
        ax.grid(alpha=.2);ax.legend(fontsize=9)
        inputs[str(path)]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        inputs[str(candidate)]=hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    fig.suptitle('Negative joint-limit profiles reject continuum unitarity of these candidates',fontsize=11)
    fig.savefig('results/impact_parameter_profiles.pdf')
    fig.savefig('results/impact_parameter_profiles.png',dpi=180)
    source=Path(__file__)
    Path('results/impact_parameter_profiles.metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(
        input_sha256=inputs,script_source_utf8=source.read_text(),
        script_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        scope='Lines are numerical quadrature; diamond error bars are exact-decimal validated enclosures. Symmetric logarithmic vertical axes use a linear interval of magnitude 1e-4.'),indent=2)+'\n')


if __name__=='__main__':main()
